text:
Jamie Tran: Quick heads-up — planning to push SDK v15.0.0 tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need final signoffs and who will flip the client-facing flag.

Sophia Li: I can own the flag flip and immediate smoke checks. Will be online 09:45 PT. What are the exact smoke steps?

Jamie Tran: Thanks. Smoke checklist: 1) API auth + token exchange OK, 2) basic generate/chat happy path, 3) embedding endpoint sanity, 4) perf: p50/p95 within baseline, 5) error rate < 0.5% across routes.

Ricardo Gomez: For perf, we should run a short 5-min load from the canary pool (50 clients). I'll queue a load job. Also adding a quick integration test for binary compat with older clients.

Maya Patel: Client comms: we need a short note in release-notes and a blurb for the SDK page about breaking changes (only one: default timeout bump). Priya can you draft? @Priya Rao?

Priya Rao: On it. Will post draft by EOD. Also adding a migration snippet for the timeout change.

Jamie Tran: Rollout strategy: staged by account percentage: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m observation windows. Immediate rollback if metric gate fails. Sample config below: 
```json
{
  "strategy": "staged",
  "stages": [5,25,100],
  "observe_window": "30m",
  "metric_gate": "error_rate < 0.5% AND latency_p95 < baseline * 1.2",
  "rollforward_on": "pass",
  "rollback_on": "fail"
}
```

Sophia Li: We should also have a manual override to pause between 25% and 100% in case of customer reports. I'll be monitoring Datadog dashboard `sdk.v15.health` and alert policy.

Ricardo Gomez: Confirming rollback play: flip flag back, drain new clients, force-old-client-compat shim (already in place), and redeploy previous SDK binary to Dedicated nodes if needed. How long to rollback end-to-end?

Jamie Tran: Target 15 minutes for flag flip + shim, 30 additional minutes for draining/validation. Longer if we need infra redeploy.

qa-ops: We'll run the pre-rollout regression suite 30 minutes prior to the push and send a green/red in the thread. plan: full smoke + two regression suites (critical paths).

deploy-bot: CI checks passed on main @ commit abc1234. Canary artefacts uploaded to registry `registry.redwood/SDK:v15-canary-2026-03-18`.

Maya Patel: Who's owner for post-deploy client support pings? We should have an oncall person for first 2 hours. Suggest @Sophia Li + @Ricardo Gomez as backup.

Sophia Li: I can take primary ops for first hour, Ricardo backup for second. I'll add it to my calendar.

Jamie Tran: Thanks all. Action items: Priya draft client note (EOD), Ricardo run 5-min load job (t-1h), qa-ops run regression (t-30m), Sophia own flag flip + dashboards (t=10:00 PT). I'll kick the deployment at 10:00 PT. Post green at +1h we update release page.

Ricardo Gomez: queued the load job — link: https://perf.redwood/jobs/4521.

Priya Rao: Draft posted here: https://confluence.redwood/sdks/v15/migration — please review.

Sophia Li: Noting: if we see increased 401s during prefix caching warmup, we pause and revert. :warning:

Jamie Tran: Copy. If anything unexpected, call the rollback and ping #eng-oncall. Otherwise we'll proceed. :thumbsup:
